description_en: Queries the details of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instance-attribute --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --expired False --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance. Call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance IDs.
<warning>Do not specify multiple instance IDs in a single request. This may cause the query to time out.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取。
<warning>请勿同时配置多个实例ID进行批量查询，否则将会查询超时导致失败。></warning>
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether the instance is expired. Valid values:

True: The instance is expired.

False: The instance is not expired
parameters.help_zh:
实例过期状态。取值：

True：已过期。
False：未过期
parameters.name: expired
